about: Two weakly-connected components with no edge between them: a chain a->b->c and a separate diamond x->{y,z}->w. Longest-path layering and the breadth-first initial order both run per component with no shared root, so this checks that a missing edge between them never merges their layers or crosses their rows (see docs/decisions/sugiyama-heuristics.md on why no virtual root is needed here).
